text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"The stream's starting~!
Setting my phone down on the desk, and... there~."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! I'm super in love with the first-look dress♡
It's so gorgeous..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"These earrings have huge jewels on them!
So celeb-level...!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice! So glittering, so high-class.
One day, I'm sure I'll be part of a world like that—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Nope! Defiii-nitely!
Someday in Dubai, with you, Train-y...♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ My heart won't stop fluttering♡
I just wanna watch forever~...♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehe! As long as I train extra hard
to make up for it, it's fine, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainie!
It's all for the sake of our sparkle, after all♡

And so, completely engrossed in live streaming,
Vivlos ended up skipping her training...
